data.narrative:
Genespire is a Series B biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector, founded by Luigi Naldini and Alessio Cantore, having raised $52M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method, using total raised as a proxy base of $52M and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $99M. The peer-median method draws from three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers with a median valuation of $3.8B and a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of revenue data, though the sector median P/S is 8.1x across the three public tickers.

Triangulating these two applicable methods yields a valuation range of $84M to $4.4B, with a median of $1.9B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around which peer cohort most appropriately anchors Genespire's position. The stage-progression method suggests a conservative floor; the peer-median approach, dominated by Series C-stage companies, may overstate comparable maturity. Revenue disclosure or clearer stage/revenue positioning would narrow this range materially.
